tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod kyi phyag len la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge blo gsal 'jug bde zhes bya ba bzhugs// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod kyi skabs phyag len 'ga' zhig thor bkod pa la/ sa chog gi snga dro/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu la/ sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs bcug pa'i rol mo gsum rdeg len dang chems brdungs rjes che ba gnyis rdeg yang dag don du la chems brdungs dang che ba gcig rdeg bde bar gshegs so la chems brdungs dang gsum rdeg len byas bzhag la/ sgeg 'phreng glu gar sogs la 'ju/ sta gon gyi snga dro 'khor ba phur bu'i tshab/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs bcas rol mo gsum rdeg rjes chems brdungs che ba gnyis rdeg yang dag don du la chems brdungs dang che ba gnyis/ bde bar gshegs so la'ang chems brdungs dang che ba gnyis/ de nas bde bar gshegs so la khyad par sogs kyi rjes/ karma kro ti shwa ri'i mjug tu gsum rdeg len byas bzhag la lha sta gon gyi mdun bskyed la 'jug pa yin/ sa chog dang sta gon/ 'cham rjes ma'i snga dro dang gtor 'bul gyi nyin te nyi ma bzhi la/ rnga byin dbab bsdus pa'i bsdus pa dang / bsdus pa'i rgyas pa gnyis mdzad/ dngos gzhi dang po'i nyin byin dbab rgyas pa'i rgyas pa/ gzhan sgrub mchod nyi ma du mdzad kyang / byin dbab rgyas pa'i bsdus pa dang / 'bring po rgyas bsdus gnyis te gsum re mos kho na mdzad/ dus chen nyin dbyangs tshes thogs/ brgyud 'debs kyi gdangs sogs 'phar ma rnams ma chag pa dang / gzhan ma dbyangs gnang dus/ bzhes dus/ dgu dus/ bcu dus rnams la 'khor ba phur bu la dbyangs rgyun pa mdzad/ gnang dus nas bcu dus bar gyi/ dbyangs yongs rdzogs re re'i nang du/ shwa na ma thung ba/ kaṅka dha ra dang / 'dod chags khros 'bar ma la shwa na ma ring ma bcug pa rnams tshar re re 'gro ba mdzad/

bcom dril gnang dgos/ sa chog gi skyob pa sangs rgyas dang shākya seṅge gnyis/ sta gon gyi bskal pa me ltar sogs snyan gsan dbab pa/ dang po'i dkyil 'khor gsol btab/ 'khor ba phur bu rnams la mdzad/ slob dpon gyi bskul dgos/ sman raka gtor gsum byin rlabs kyi/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha snga ma dang / 'khor ba phur bu rnams rgyun par bskul ba mdzad/ bum bskyed byung re bzhin/ bum bskyed mdzad pa zhu zhes dang / gtor bsngo'i mgor/ gtor ma byin rlabs mdzad pa zhu/ zhes gsungs pa tsam byed/ gzhan rnams bskul res su yin gyis byas pas chog sbyin bdag gi bsngo ba/ shi bsngo/ gson bsngo ma nor ba byed pa gal che/ sngon sngags 'chang chen po/ khri chen bde gshegs/ yab rje bde gshegs sogs zhal ngo bgres pa chog dpon la phebs dus/ sa chog gi phyogs bzhi gsol btab skabs/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su sku chas bzhugs ngos khri'u chung la bzhugs nas/ de nas badz+ra kī li kī la ya sogs nas bgegs skrod dang / hūm̐ chen ka ra sogs khro bo'i stangs stabs dang / e pha ra sogs nas/ steng phyogs tshangs bsnol kī la ya'i 'gros/ phur btab sogs kyi sku 'cham rnams rdo rje slob dpon bgres pa de rang gis mdzad/ gzhan ma phyi'i 'cham rgyas pa rnams zhal ngo gzhon pa des mdzad pa na rim bzhin 'byung ba yin/ bum pa yang zhal ngo bgres gzhon kun gyis bcas nas/ gzhon pa rnams goms pa'i phyir dbang re mos kyis bskur du 'jug pa mdzad cing / bum pa bcas pas ras bris kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dod tsam tshang ba 'di sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag len yin zhing / 'di cis kyang rung ba'i rgyu mtshan don gnyer yod na ngag las stsal/ yang zhal ngo bgres pa 'cham gyi rol dpon tsam la phebs shing / chog dpon gzhon pa kho nas mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'cham rjes ma'i rnga 'cham grub mtshams/ zhal ngo gzhon pa chog dpon su yin de/ zhal ngo bgres pa'i sku mdun phyogs su bzhugs grum steng mchod g.yog pa dang lhan cig byon nas cho ga'i kha lag tshang ba'i phyir/

gser skyems/ phur kha bsgyur ba/ rig 'dzin bskul/ dpang gzugs rnams ma tshar bar bzhugs nas/ de nas dzam nyug sogs kyi rol dpon mdzad pa'am nang du log pa gang bde yin/ sa chog gi hūm̐ chen ka ra/ steng phyogs tshangs bsnol ma/ steng yang ma sogs kyi dbyangs kyi skabs/ zhal ngo bgres pa de lha khang chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar lho'am/ lho nub kyi ka ba'i gdong du khri'u shing la bzhugs pa la/ mgur 'degs pa dbu mdzad sogs g.yas g.yon du 'khod/ zhal ngo gzhon pa 'cham dpon su yin de dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas zhal shar la gzigs nas 'cham sogs mdzad pa yin/ rnga 'cham gyi dbyangs kyi skabs/ zhal ngo bgres pa rol dpon mdzad mkhan de yang bzhugs gdan steng du bzhengs/ de'i mdun du bzhugs gdan med par 'cham char gyi steng zhal ngo gzhon pa rnams bsgrigs pa'i g.yas g.yon la dbu mdzad sogs mgur 'degs pa rnams bsgrigs nas gsung dbyangs mdzad pa yin/ yang zhal ngo bgres pa rol dpon la yang ma phebs tshe/ 'cham dpon su yin khri'u shing gi steng du phebs pa'i sku mdun la mgur 'degs pa rnams 'khod nas byed/ gzhan ma rtsa 'cham/ rnga 'cham/ grub 'cham gyi stangs stabs rkang grangs yongs rdzogs rnams kyi dka' gnas kyi gsal byed/ chog sgrigs byed lugs/ tshogs skad gtong tshul tshun chad sngags 'chang chen po yab sras kyi phyag len bzhin/ nged rang gis byas pa'i 'cham dpe nye mkho tsho gsum yod pa de dag gi nang du gsal bar yod/ sgrub mchod grol ba'i nyin lhag ma la mngon rtogs kyi dbyangs/ dpal gyi pho nya ring thung sgo ma'i bstod bskul gyi dbyangs/ yang dag don du/ bdag nyid ma/ dkyil 'khor phyi rim ma/ shwa na ma thung ba rnams/ 'jig rten las 'das ma snga phyi/ phra man/ 'bar ma/ ma bdun/ re ma ti/ bdud 'dul rnams la 'jug pa mdzad/ sgrub mchod kyi nyi ma gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i skabs dbyangs res gnang dus kyi tshe/

ye shes sku mchog e las ma/ gtso bo'i bskyed dbyangs/ skye med ma/ khro rgyal 'dus pa sogs dbyangs grong spod dgos gang yod/ dngos gzhi dang po'i nyin bzhin ma chad pa mdzad/ grub 'cham kyi skabs/ rkyang 'gros kyis thon nas/ dgug gzhug gsum grub mtshams/ g.yas log g.yon log mi byed par rol mo 'then rkang dang bcas 'cham dpon gyi bca' sgrigs/ rol mo ring tsam dang bcas pad skor gcig de nas dzam sogs byas la 'cham dngos rnams la 'jug pa'i tshul 'cham dpe rgyas bsdus rnams su gsal ba de yin/ der cung mi gsal ba la/ seṅge'i brjid 'cham nas dred mo'i bar la gsol ja sogs kyi mtshams bcad na rol mo chems brdung gi rjes la 'then rkang gnyis gsum bar 'chams dpon gyi bca' sgrigs la/ de nas pad skor ring tsam zhig byas rjes 'cham dngos gzhi so so la 'jug pa yin/ dgug gzhug rting ma'i chems brdung nas bzung phyi nang gsang ba'i bar la g.yas log g.yon log kho na byed pa lags/ tshogs skad gtong ba'i dus chog sgrigs kyi nyin de'i sgrigs rim byed tshul gyi mtshams sbyor la gcig dbang bskur tshugs pa'i nyin grwa pa rnams la rnga 'cham grub mtshams phyi dbyangs sbyong dgos lugs la gcig gtor 'bul gyi snga dro legs so byin pa'i tshul gyi thengs gcig rnams gtong ba yab bde gshegs kyis phyag len la mdzad/ sngags 'chang chen po ni yang yang gnang ba zhig yod pa 'dug de kha bzhin nged rang gis kyang sna tshogs byas pa de yin/ yang tshogs skad ma btang yang 'gal ba ni cher med/ sgrub mchod nyi ma rjes ma'i mjug chog gi skabs/ dngos grub zhu ba'i tshig bcad ye shes lnga ldan la gdangs ring thung gsum mdzad pa ma chad pa gal che zhing / yang rtsa 'cham rgyas pa mi mdzad pa khro bo rol pa'i stangs stabs tsam mdzad na/ sngags 'chang chen po'i 'cham dpe bzhin nged rang gis logs su bkol ba'i yi ger gsal ba ltar mdzad pas chog cing /

bsdus pa'i phyogs la sa chog skor bzhag nas/ sta gon gyi tshe bdag bskyed phur 'bring dkyil 'khor gsum bskyed pa yan byas rjes/ sa'i lha mo sta gon gyi cho ga byas la/ de nas lha sta gon/ snyan gsan dbab pa/ bum pa sta gon rnams mdzad pa dkyus bzhin dang / phur bkod ni phur pa yod phyin byas na legs/ rgyal chen tho 'dzugs ni ma byas kyang chog pa yin/ dngos gzhi'i sgrub mchod gtong tshul ni rgyas pa'i skabs dang khyad par cher med pas de ltar du shes par bya'o// //zhes pa rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod kyi phyag len la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge blo gsal 'jug bde zhes bya ba 'di yang 'khon ston sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug la bsam zhing / gzhan yang gsar bu'i blo can rnams kyi don du bzhi thog bla brang gi mkha' spyod dpal gyi pho brang du mgyogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa go re len gyi zhabs rtog la rtag 'grus su bgyid pa bsod nams rab brtan gyis gus spro'i sgo nas bgyis so/ /bsod nams 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /phyi ma thogs med dag pa'i zhing 'dzoms nas/ /sprul pas sngags 'chang bstan pa rgyas byed shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ gcig zhus// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod kyi phyag len la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge blo gsal 'jug bde/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
